how_to_apply: Visit the official RRB application portal.
Open the application for CEN No. 06/2026 – NTPC Graduate.
Select Create an Account if you do not already have an RRB account.
Candidates who created an account for earlier RRB CENs in 2024, 2025 or 2026 should use the same login credentials.
Complete Aadhaar/DigiLocker identity authentication where applicable.
Enter personal, educational, category and other required details.
Choose eligible Railway/Production Unit and post preferences.
Capture the live photograph through the application portal.
Upload the signature in the prescribed format.
Submit the application before 06 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Save the registration details and submitted application for future reference.

Important: Candidates must submit only one application against CEN No. 06/2026. Multiple applications to the same or different RRBs can lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC examinations.
The application modification window will be open from 09 November to 18 November 2026.
Candidates can modify eligible application details by paying a ₹250 non-refundable modification fee for each occasion.
Details entered under Create an Account, including mobile number and email ID, and the Chosen RRB cannot be changed.
important_instructions: Read CEN No. 06/2026 completely before submitting the application. Applications can be submitted only through online mode. Select only one RRB. Submit only one application against CEN 06/2026. Candidates awaiting their final graduation result are not eligible. Check the medical standard applicable to each post before giving post preference. Goods Train Manager requires A2 medical standard. Capture the live photograph exactly according to the instructions. Upload the signature only in the prescribed format and size. Keep your registered mobile number and email ID active throughout the recruitment process. Details entered in Create an Account and the selected RRB cannot be changed later. Check all details carefully before the application deadline.

content_sections.text: A total of 3,548 vacancies have been announced under RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026. The highest number of vacancies is for Goods Train Manager with 2,750 posts. The RRB-wise, Railway Zone-wise and post-wise distribution of vacancies is provided in Annexure B of CEN No. 06/2026. content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Graduate Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Degree from a recognized University or its equivalent for all four posts under RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026. Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification on or before 06 November 2026 . Candidates awaiting the final result of the qualifying examination are not eligible to apply. content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Graduate Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment process for RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026 consists of: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT 1) 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT 2) Document Verification Medical Examination There is no Typing Skill Test under CEN 06/2026, including for Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist and Senior Clerk cum Typist. Candidates will be shortlisted for Document Verification RRB-wise in the ratio of approximately 1:1 against the notified vacancies , based on merit and the applicable recruitment rules.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Graduate Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC Graduate online application process starts on 08 October 2026 . Candidates must complete their application by 06 November 2026 at 11:59 PM .

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official RRB application portal. Open the application for CEN No. 06/2026 – NTPC Graduate . Select Create an Account if you do not already have an RRB account. Candidates who created an account for earlier RRB CENs in 2024, 2025 or 2026 should use the same login credentials. Complete Aadhaar/DigiLocker identity authentication where applicable. Select only one RRB carefully. Enter personal, educational, category and other required details. Choose eligible Railway/Production Unit and post preferences. Capture the live photograph through the application portal. Upload the signature in the prescribed format. Pay the applicable examination fee. Preview all information carefully. Submit the application before 06 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Save the registration details and submitted application for future reference. Important: Candidates must submit only one application against CEN No. 06/2026. Multiple applications to the same or different RRBs can lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC examinations. The application modification window will be open from 09 November to 18 November 2026 . Candidates can modify eligible application details by paying a ₹250 non-refundable modification fee for each occasion . Details entered under Create an Account , including mobile number and email ID, and the Chosen RRB cannot be changed.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Graduate Photo and Signature Size 2026
content_sections.text: For RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026, candidates are not required to upload a pre-existing passport photograph . The application portal will capture a live photograph during the online application process. The photograph must be captured live using a computer/laptop webcam or mobile phone front camera. Use a pure plain white background. Wear non-white clothing, preferably a plain dark colour, to maintain contrast. Look directly at the camera with a neutral expression. The entire face must be clearly visible and centered. The head should occupy at least 50% of the photograph area. Do not wear a cap, mask or spectacles while capturing the photograph. Do not photograph a printed or existing digital photograph. Important: Since the photograph is captured live, there is no separate RRB NTPC photo upload size or KB requirement for a pre-existing photograph under CEN 06/2026. The signature must be written by the candidate in normal running handwriting. Signatures written in BLOCK LETTERS, CAPITAL LETTERS or disjointed letters are not accepted.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Signature Compressor and Image Resizer
content_sections.text: If the scanned signature does not meet the RRB NTPC upload requirements, candidates can use the FreeJobAlert Image Resizer to resize and compress it before uploading. For RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026, keep the signature in JPG/JPEG format, between 30 KB and 49 KB, with minimum dimensions of 140 × 60 pixels . Sign on white paper using a black ink pen. Scan the signature clearly. Open the FreeJobAlert Image Resizer . Keep the image dimensions at least 140 × 60 pixels. Compress the file to between 30 KB and 49 KB. Save the final image in JPG or JPEG format. Check that the signature is complete, clear and clearly visible before uploading.

faq.question: Q1. Is RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026 notification released?
faq.answer: Yes. Railway Recruitment Boards have released CEN No. 06/2026 for recruitment to graduate-level Non-Technical Popular Category posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RRB NTPC Graduate 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3,548 vacancies under CEN No. 06/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 06 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the RRB NTPC signature size 2026?
faq.answer: The signature should be in JPG/JPEG format, between 30 KB and 49 KB, with minimum dimensions of 140 × 60 pixels.

faq.question: Q5. What is the RRB NTPC photo size for CEN 06/2026?
faq.answer: There is no separate pre-existing photo upload size under CEN 06/2026. Candidates must capture a live photograph through the application portal while filling the online form.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply to more than one RRB under CEN 06/2026?
faq.answer: No. Candidates can select only one RRB and must submit only one application under CEN 06/2026.

faq.question: Q7. When is the RRB NTPC Graduate CBT exam date?
faq.answer: The CBT dates have not yet been announced. RRBs will publish the examination schedule separately on the official websites.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary of RRB NTPC Graduate posts?
faq.answer: The initial pay is ₹35,400 for Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor and ₹29,200 for Goods Train Manager, Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist and Senior Clerk cum Typist.
